approval: Root explicitly authorized an abstract shared operational review unit. Only source-owner reported transport, input and adoption metadata are included; no game scripts, constants, raw responses, private paths, oracle values or installation material are published.
population: Selected examples, not a census of the16 cloud workers or a count of all tasks. Grouped paired roles remain distinct requests; no old case or native tool round is counted again.
input_basis: Source owners reported complete actual source prefixes and three-message/Task checks where held. These metadata reports are not an independent declaration-closure proof by the operational sealer. Complete source presence, strict outer JSON and semantic correctness are separate.

applicability.runtime_authority: Current actual Native legality remains the final gate. Only independently reviewed version-independent defects may enter ordinary Java review.

selected_examples.findings: Some formula facts were retained; provenance, nested scope and undocumented display/restart defaults required owner correction.
A supplied negated condition was omitted, source locations were wrong and absence in one branch was generalized to no action in the entire domain.
Scaled integer values were multiplied again, missing/unknown evidence became failure, a concrete regression was misread and loaded parity was assumed without evidence.
No CONTENT read, extraction, fragment adoption, continuation or semantic retry. Owner derived a separate contract from the frozen originals.
The response ignored complete supplied helper definitions, treated declared boolean/unknown inputs as undefined and exceeded the requested finding count. No new rule or code was adopted.
Whole answer discarded unread; no splicing, adoption or semantic retry. Length is not evidence of a specific source-code defect.
Conjunctions became conditional scopes, a negated equality was negated twice and a scope was invented.
An AI-only threshold became a general requirement, a level became a balance and eligibility was confused with acceptance; another condition lacked source proof.
Only narrow input-presence/uncertainty labels were retained. Conditional branches were flattened, a fallback was omitted and a ruler scope was misapplied to successor eligibility.
Both complete answers returned empty changes. A negative conclusion relied on incorrect supplied return semantics, so it was not a proof that no qualified patch existed.

The proposed winner and scaled delta were wrong and a required return type was absent. The witness's first selection contradicted its own arithmetic; four later conservative facts were only limited corroboration.
Safe quote/timing boundaries were retained. A generic high-price case did not prove the required unknown-state behavior; readback and repeated-name semantic uncertainty were incomplete.

One response asserted false for a supported predicate. The other invented APIs, omitted return types and used incorrect array equality. Owner selected two plus three independent cases without a new production patch.

One target line was correct but unrelated behavior and enum syntax changed. Test capture/current mismatches, private-predicate copying, a null path that bypassed the target and missing imports invalidated the rest. The owner had an independent narrow edit; it was not model credit.

adoption_limits.analysis_retention: Only the explicitly limited owner-corrected labels or corroboration in each example

costs.source_discovery_preparation_owner_repai: Separate phases; some overlap the HTTP intervals.

operating_lessons: Review boolean structure, units, source scope, fallback order and UNKNOWN separately rather than accepting an overall correct-looking conclusion.
A complete negative answer does not establish impossibility; complete current declarations and concrete call edges still need review.
A correct small hunk does not authorize unrelated edits. Independently completed owner code must not be relabeled as model adoption.
Length answers stay wholly unread and unscored. Do not guess a semantic failure from missing final content or splice a continuation.
Metadata-only transport audits and source semantic adjudication need separate records. Preserve old cutoffs and add later software evidence separately.

owner_review_addenda.scope: Existing negative-patch consumer example; independent Root/owner review after its first candidate
owner_review_addenda.problem: The first owner precheck could throw before an existing fallback when upstream formal data were stale or a codec input was invalid. An owner Test had incorrectly expected this earlier exception, so its expectation did not establish equivalence.
owner_review_addenda.correction: A new owner revision catches IllegalArgumentException only around the pure predictor and returns false to retain the original fallback. Actual reads and final binding stay outside that catch.
owner_review_addenda.old_actual_software_if_any: Preserved without guessing an unheld result
owner_review_addenda.lesson: Review the Test expectation and the error/fallback order independently; neither a model negative answer nor an existing Test result establishes behavioral equivalence.
